name: aigent-talking-head
summary: Turn a phone clip into a captioned, styled 9:16 talking-head reel, locally.
invoke: npm run <command> -- <args>  (from the repo root; or node <script> <args>)

types.boolean: a flag with no value; present means true
types.number: a numeric value after the flag
types.path: a file or folder path, relative to the current folder unless noted

env.name: PYTHON
env.description: Python that has requirements.txt installed (default python3, or py on Windows)

env.name: CHROME_PATH
env.description: Chrome or Chromium binary when it is not found automatically

env.name: TX_MODEL
env.description: Whisper model clip.py uses when reel gets no --model (default small.en; large-v3 is the slow, most accurate opt-in)

env.name: NOSFX
env.description: 1 turns off sounds in reel and fx (same as --sfx off)

env.name: FX_MATTE
env.description: person-mask backend for fx when no --mask is given

env.name: FX_WSL
env.description: Windows only: Python inside WSL that runs the effects

env.name: FX_WSL_DISTRO
env.description: Windows only: the WSL distro for FX_WSL

env.name: REA_VIDEO
env.description: path to the rea-video binary for teardown

env.name: FREESOUND_API_KEY
env.description: only for searching new sounds; nothing else needs a key

graphics.where: a reel-graphics block in a Reel.md (one line per graphic: #NN start-end | type <id> | field value ...), or captions.js flips with the mode
rules: fields under spoken must be words you say in the graphic's window (near-homophones and the recipe's Aliases count); a recipe job drops a graphic only when a field under required is not said, and otherwise leaves off just the unsaid field (kit/spoken.cjs)
while a graphic is up, captions and titles that would sit on it move clear or hide (the layout pass in kit/overlay.html); npm run verify fails on any overlap
layer behind puts the graphic under the crown mask: only the top of your head goes over it, never your face or chin

types.summary: list number sticker: an italic serif word (FIRST, SECOND, NEXT) set on a flat seal in the theme accent; the seal can sit behind your head
app or logo label: a top-lit icon tile springs in and a name plate wipes out under it; your icon image, or a monogram of the name

screen card: a dark window card (title bar, address pill, accent rim with a glow), inset in the lower middle, showing your screenshot or screen recording; optional pointer clicks and pan and zoom keyframes on beats you say
lower third name tag: an accent rule springs up, a name plate wipes out from it and a small line follows on an accent tab
big number callout: the number blurs in and counts up to its value in equal digit cells, accent gradient and glow, a label plate rises under it
checklist card: rows slide in, and each check springs in and draws its tick as you say its item; a done count in the header
quote card: a quote mark springs in, the line fades up word by word in an italic serif, with a small attribution under it
highlight: a tapered marker circle, arrow, underline or box draws itself on with a glow, with an optional short label on an accent plate
step counter: a plate with the step number rolling over in an accent disc, STEP 2 OF 5 beside it and a segmented bar that fills to the current step
versus card: two halves slide in from the sides and a VS badge slams between them
round icon badge: springs in while its conic ring draws round; a built-in glyph (Tabler icon) or your icon, with an optional label plate
reaction stickers: a little cluster of die-cut vinyl stickers (hearts, stars, fire, sparks) springs in around a point and floats up
price tag: a price card rises and springs into place, the price big with a raised currency sign and an old price struck through above
call-to-action end card: a card rises with an avatar ring, your line and handle, and a follow button pulses with ripples

code snippet card: an editor window with a file tab, line numbers and a current-line band, the code typing itself on with syntax colour and a caret; the card widens or the type steps down so no line is clipped
data chart card: gridlines draw, then each bar (or each point of a line) grows on its beat with a spring while its value counts up; the top value glows in the accent
chapter card: a soft scrim and accent rule, CHAPTER 02 and the title rising out of a mask line by line, a ghost numeral behind and progress ticks
logo bug: your mark (an icon file, else a monogram tile in the accent) springs into a corner with its name on a dark plate; a slow sheen passes now and then
channel bug: a red LIVE pill with a breathing dot, a running clock in tabular digits and the channel name, on dark plates in a corner
terminal session: a terminal window rises; each $ command types on its beat with a spinner, then its output lands line by line (ticks green, errors red); a block cursor blinks
news strap: a broadcast lower third; a light plate wipes out from an accent bar with the headline, a tag tab drops onto its top edge and the sub line slides in on a dark strip
ticker: a full-width band rises from the bottom edge with a slanted accent label block; the items you say scroll right to left between accent diamonds
split-flap board: hinged departure-board tiles flip through letters and land on your words left to right in Anton; a second row in the accent
feature cards: two to four cards deal in side by side as you say each feature, with an icon tile in the accent, a number, the feature and a short line; the newest card glows
release pill: a glass pill springs in with an accent NEW chip (its dot pulsing a ring), your line and an arrow; a sheen sweeps across once
CTA button: a lit accent button rises, a pointer glides in and clicks it (the button squashes and flashes, a ripple rings out); a sub line under it
HUD callout: corner brackets spin in and lock onto a region (a flash, centre ticks, a scan line), a leader line draws out with an elbow to a label that decodes into place
flash cards: full-bleed type cards, one word each in Anton, hard cut on each beat with a punch-in, alternating accent and ink grounds; covers the frame
keyword caption: a caption line rises word by word, then a solid accent block wipes in behind the keyword and its letters flip to ink on it; an optional tag above
number pop: a listicle intro, the numbers 1 to N pop in one by one on solid tiles around your head (alternating sides, never over the face), hold, then pop out together; pair it with a pop sound

commands.name: reel
commands.summary: Phone clip (or several takes) to a draft reel: clip, cut, captions, titles, render, assemble.

positional.name: videos
positional.description: takes to use; default is every video from the newest recording session in inbox/

flags.name: clip
flags.description: the video to use (same as a positional path)

flags.name: clips
flags.description: reuse an existing clip.py folder and skip transcription

flags.name: newest
flags.description: inbox: newest file only

flags.name: name
flags.description: job name under jobs/

flags.name: jobs
flags.description: jobs folder

flags.name: preset
flags.description: a preset name from npm run preset, or auto

flags.name: recipe
flags.description: a Reel.md recipe (docs/reel-md.md)

flags.name: recipe-titles
flags.description: use the recipe's title text and times, only where you say that text

flags.name: capture-sources
flags.description: capture the recipe's confirmed screen-card sources first (public pages)

flags.name: theme
flags.description: a theme in kit/themes/ (aigent, neutral, or your own)

flags.name: style
flags.description: caption style override

flags.name: titles
flags.description: force kinetic titles on

flags.name: no-titles
flags.description: no kinetic titles

flags.name: fonts
flags.description: font pairing names from kit/fonts/pairings.json or kit/fonts/local; several cycle one per title

flags.name: caption-layer
flags.default: auto for top captions, front otherwise
flags.description: captions under the person where they overlap the head; auto puts top captions behind

flags.name: panel-layer
flags.description: screen cards behind the head where it reaches into them; auto means behind

flags.name: caption-entrance
flags.description: how kinetic hero words enter, letter by letter (rewritten from the MIT SwiftUI thinking-text catalog)

flags.name: mask
flags.description: person-mask backend for titles behind the head

flags.name: no-mask
flags.description: skip the person mask

flags.name: no-punch
flags.description: no zoom punch on cuts

flags.name: tighten
flags.description: no dead air: cut every pause inside a line longer than this many seconds to a jump (0.15 to 2)

flags.name: no-tighten
flags.description: keep every pause, even when the preset tightens

flags.name: cards
flags.description: colour cards on short lines to land, numbered chapter cards and a number-pop intro on a counted list

flags.name: aliases
flags.description: names Whisper mishears, written your way in captions and titles: "Gwyn: Guinn, Gwin; aigent: agent" (adds to a recipe's Aliases)

flags.name: no-boost
flags.description: skip the legibility pass that gives a low-contrast caption moment a denser halo

flags.name: music-energy
flags.description: pick a library bed by energy; auto reads your pace; --bed still wins

flags.name: cropx
flags.description: horizontal crop centre, 0 to 1 (0.4 puts the face left of centre)

flags.name: model
flags.description: Whisper model for clip.py: small.en is fast on a CPU; large-v3 is the most accurate and slow, a ~3 GB download the first time (a notice prints before any download)

flags.name: hook
flags.description: take to use for the first sentence

flags.name: broll
flags.description: folder of your own cutaway clips

flags.name: bed
flags.description: a bed name from npm run music, or an audio file path

flags.name: bed-start
flags.description: seconds into the bed to start

flags.name: beat-sync
flags.description: snap punches, sounds, titles and fx hits to the bed (on by default when a bed is set)

flags.name: finish
flags.description: film finishes

flags.name: logo
flags.description: logo file for the end card

flags.name: sfx
flags.description: off skips the locked-set sounds

flags.name: no-sfx
flags.description: same as --sfx off

flags.name: no-sfx-cap
flags.description: turn off the sound density cap (at least 0.25 s apart, at most 6 in any 10 s, by default)

flags.name: draft
flags.description: stop after captions.js so it can be edited

flags.name: rebuild
flags.description: re-render and re-assemble an edited job (use with --name)

flags.name: force
flags.description: re-clip and redraft over an existing job

flags.name: export
flags.description: lay the reel out for that platform's safe area and also write reel-vN-<name>.mp4 (crop, length and bitrate caps in kit/exports.json); kept in cut.json for later --rebuild runs

flags.name: json
flags.description: print one JSON result line at the end: { ok, job, dir, reel, export, exportPreset, seconds, layout: { moved, hidden, safeArea }, verify } (or { ok: false, error })

outputs: jobs/<name>/clips/clips.json and clips.md (best take per sentence, retakes flagged)
jobs/<name>/build/cut.json, captions.js, theme.js and overlay frames
jobs/<name>/reel-vN.mp4 (a new number each run; earlier versions are kept)
jobs/<name>/build/layout.json: what the layout pass moved clear of a graphic, hid while one was up, or placed inside the export's safe area
commands.success: prints "Reel: <path>" (or "Draft ready." with --draft); with --json the last line is the JSON result
failures: No video given and inbox/ has none
build/cut.json exists: use --rebuild to render edits or --force to redraft
an invalid enum value: "--<flag> must be ..."

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Propose graphics from what you say (numbers, lists, steps, quotes, commands, the call to action) into a Reel.md to review before rendering.

positional.name: job

flags.name: out
flags.description: where to write; an existing Reel.md is merged (its graphics stay, proposals fill the gaps)

flags.name: base
flags.description: start a new plan from this recipe's brand, music and style

flags.name: max
flags.description: at most this many graphics

flags.name: fresh
flags.description: propose again over lines an earlier plan wrote (they carry why); lines you wrote always stay

flags.name: dry
flags.description: print the Reel.md, write nothing

flags.name: cards
flags.description: propose colour cards and chapter cards (on by default when the recipe uses cards, as the magazine preset does)

flags.name: no-cards
flags.description: no colour or chapter cards

flags.name: jobs
flags.description: jobs folder

flags.name: json
flags.description: print one JSON result line at the end: { ok, recipe, seconds, proposed, kept, dropped, fuzzy, next }

outputs: jobs/<job>/Reel.md with a reel-graphics block; each proposed line carries why it was proposed
commands.success: prints PLAN OK and the reel command to run next
failures: <Reel.md>: fix it first (an existing recipe with errors)

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Check a finished reel before handing it over: ffprobe, loudness, overlap between graphics, captions and titles (measured from pixels), the export safe area, mask, copy lint and stills.

positional.name: job
positional.description: job name in jobs/ (or a job folder path)

flags.name: file
flags.default: newest reel-fx-vN.mp4 or reel-vN.mp4 in the job
flags.description: the video to check

flags.name: fps
flags.description: expected frame rate

flags.name: export
flags.description: check that export (newest reel-vN-<name>.mp4): its size and length cap, and that every title, caption and graphic sits inside the platform's safe area; stills shade the UI zones red

flags.name: json
flags.description: print one JSON result line at the end: { ok, file, export, fails, notes, stills, contact, report }

outputs: jobs/<job>/verify/: one still per check point (including the middle of every graphic's window), contact.png, report.md
jobs/<job>/build/boxes.json: every element's measured box at each check point

commands.summary: Lint a job's captions and cut against the edit rules; with no job, self-test the repo (examples, recipes, menu, showcase, this contract).
